answer: The karst test I would run is Famed seaplane pilot registration with seaplane pilots attestation: a registration pilots renew after hull audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration pilots renew after hull audits stays private; the knoll is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the lotus of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
